name: Roanoke County, VA
findings: Roanoke County has 292 nonprofit organizations. 138 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 101 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Roanoke County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 12 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
